LanguageData.JJK_Settings_RandomGenesOnPawnGen: Pawns can spawn with cursed genes
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_RandomGenesOnPawnGen_Tip: When enabled, newly generated humanlike pawns have a small chance to roll a cursed energy reserve gene (or, very rarely, a heavenly restriction) at character generation.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_MoodScalesCE: Low mood boosts cursed energy regeneration
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_MoodScalesCE_Tip: When enabled, sorcerers with low mood regenerate cursed energy faster, reflecting that curses are born of negative emotion.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_EnemyDomains_Tip: When enabled, non-player sorcerers of sufficient grade will manifest their Domain Expansion during combat. Disable to make domains player-only.
LanguageData.JJK_Settings_CorpseCurses_Tip: When enabled, the more corpses left lying on a home map, the more likely cursed spirits are to coalesce out of them and attack. Bury or cremate the dead to stay safe. Disable to turn this off.
LanguageData.JJK_GradeXpMaxed: Grade XP: {0} (maximum grade reached by training)
LanguageData.JJK_SoulMenderAwakened: After countless hours over other people's wounds, {0} has finally understood a body that is not their own.\n\nTheir reverse cursed technique now reaches outward: {0} can mend another pawn's injuries at a touch. It is far more draining than healing themselves - the technique closes less of the wound for far more cursed energy - but no other sorcerer in a thousand can do it at all.
LanguageData.JJK_ShikigamiTamingStarted: An untamed {0} has manifested - hostile to all. Defeat it to tame it.
LanguageData.JJK_ShikigamiTamed: {0} has tamed the {1}. It can now be summoned as an ally.
LanguageData.JJK_ShikigamiLost: The {0} has been destroyed and can never be summoned again.
LanguageData.JJK_ShikigamiLostMessage: {0}'s {1} has been slain - it is lost forever.
LanguageData.JJK_MahoragaWheelTurning: Mahoraga's wheel begins studying {1}. It will fully heal when the spin completes.
LanguageData.JJK_MahoragaAdapting: Mahoraga's wheel turns and fully restores its body. Its resistance to {1} deepens.
LanguageData.JJK_MahoragaImmune: Mahoraga has fully adapted to {1}. This phenomenon can no longer overcome it.
LanguageData.JJK_MahoragaSurvived: Mahoraga regenerates and refuses to die to {1}, a phenomenon it has already adapted to.
LanguageData.JJK_AttackTargetDesc: Order this shikigami to attack a chosen enemy.
LanguageData.JJK_RecallShikigamiDesc: Dismiss this shikigami, returning it to the shadows unharmed. Use this to save a wounded shikigami before it is killed - a recalled shikigami can be summoned again, but a slain one is lost forever.
LanguageData.JJK_DomainNeedsReserve: Cursed energy reserve too small to manifest a domain (needs {0}).
LanguageData.JJK_CollapseDomainDesc: Willingly dismiss this Domain Expansion. A voluntary collapse leaves a much shorter burnout (6 hours) than letting the domain run dry or break (24 hours).
LanguageData.JJK_CollapseSimpleDomainDesc: Dismiss this Simple Domain. As a basic defensive technique it leaves no burnout at all, so you can drop it and raise it again freely.
LanguageData.JJK_DomainInside: Standing within your own domain: cursed technique amplified and sure-hit.
LanguageData.JJK_DomainOutside: Holding the domain open from outside it: no personal amplification.
LanguageData.JJK_CorpseCurseText: The dead left lying on your land have festered into cursed energy. {0} cursed spirits coalesce out of the corpses and turn on the living.\n\nExorcise them - and consider burying or cremating your dead before more curses are born.
LanguageData.JJK_DomainClashStalemate: {0}'s and {1}'s domains clash as equals and shatter each other.
LanguageData.JJK_SimpleDomainShattered: {0}'s Simple Domain has been shattered by a hostile domain.
LanguageData.JJK_VowAlreadyBound: already bound by a binding vow
LanguageData.JJK_VowActive: The vow's condition is met: its power is active.
LanguageData.JJK_VowDormant: The vow's condition is not met: its power lies dormant.
LanguageData.JJK_BoogieNeedsHands: needs two working hands to clap
LanguageData.JJK_HairpinResonanceHit: Hairpin: Resonance detonated nails in {0} target(s)
LanguageData.JJK_PhaseDagon: The cursed womb convulses and matures - Dagon, the Disaster Curse of the sea, has completed its metamorphosis. It rises at full strength.
LanguageData.JJK_PhaseMahito: Cornered, Mahito reshapes its own soul into its purest killing form - the Instant Spirit Body of Distorted Killing. It is faster and deadlier than before.
LanguageData.JJK_RemnantLearned: {0} absorbed the remnant and gained the {1} technique.
LanguageData.JJK_RemnantNotHuman: only a humanlike pawn can absorb a technique
LanguageData.JJK_RemnantRestricted: a heavenly restriction bars all cursed techniques
LanguageData.JJK_UzumakiUnleashed: {0} unleashed Maximum: Uzumaki, compressing {1} curses into a blast of {2} damage.
LanguageData.JJK_FingerConsumed: {0} consumed one of Sukuna's fingers. The King of Curses' influence deepens.
LanguageData.JJK_DismissSummonDesc: Return {0} to the shadows. The summon leaves the field unharmed; it is not lost and can be summoned again.
LanguageData.JJK_KenjakuLetter1: Somewhere beyond the world's edge, a brain wrapped in stitched flesh considers your colony with mild interest. "A promising vessel or two," it muses. "Let them ripen."
LanguageData.JJK_KenjakuLetter2: The schemer turns another page of a plan a thousand years in the writing. Your sorcerers are a variable he has already accounted for — or so he believes.
LanguageData.JJK_KenjakuLetter3: "Evolution favors the cursed," he says to no one. A new arrangement of curses drifts toward the inhabited rim, patient and inevitable.
LanguageData.JJK_KenjakuLetter4: He has worn a hundred faces and forgotten most of the names. Yours, for now, he chooses to remember.
LanguageData.JJK_KenjakuLetter5: A binding vow is whispered into the dark, its terms unknowable to you. The price, as always, will be paid by someone else.
LanguageData.JJK_KenjakuLetter6: "Grow stronger," the note seems to say. "It will be more interesting when I take it from you."
LanguageData.JJK_RCTAwakeningText: After surviving a brush with death, {0} has understood how to reverse cursed energy. They can now learn to heal themselves with reverse cursed technique. They must still pay its cursed-energy cost; this awakening has not healed their injuries.
LanguageData.JJK_RCTInsightPending: Recover from being downed before this condition expires for one {0}% awakening chance. The outcome is saved; reloading does not roll again.
LanguageData.JJK_RCTInsightResolved: This opportunity has been resolved. Another qualifying injury can offer insight after this condition expires.
LanguageData.JJK_VowOnClock: On the clock: 80% technique output (08:00-18:00 local time).
LanguageData.JJK_CastPracticeProgress: Casting practice: {0}/40 rewards available; window resets in {1}. Each paid cast grants 3 base grade XP and 2 mastery. Free controls grant none; successful puppet orders qualify through core costs. Kills, lessons and study have separate rewards.
